process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. This hit gh pr view 222, git diff --stat fde86d1e..HEAD, git rev-parse HEAD and git status --porcelain. The bubblewrap sandbox can't start on this runner, so the PR diff, metadata, threads and head SHA couldn't be read.

No reviewers were spawned. They run in the same sandbox and need the same gh/git reads to scope the change, so they would have failed the same way. PR #222 was NOT reviewed, and this record must not be read as a clean review. Re-run once the runner allows the sandbox to start (needs CAP_SYS_ADMIN or unprivileged user namespaces) or with sandboxing configured off for this job.
